biotools.summary: Reslice3Dto2D is a software tool for reformatting 3D cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) volumes into 2D slices, enabling standardized post-processing and comparison with 2D acquisitions. It utilizes a two-step interpolation method and is validated on clinical data.
